note.after_visit_summary: Your grandson had an asthma flare from a cold. His oxygen was a bit low at first, and his lungs had wheezing, but after a breathing treatment he did much better. His oxygen improved and his breathing slowed down. We started a medicine by mouth called prednisolone: 10 milliliters (30 mg) once a day for 5 days. You also get his first dose today. Use albuterol 4 puffs with a spacer every 4 hours while he is awake for 2 days, then only as needed. Restart fluticasone: 2 puffs twice a day. He should rinse his mouth after using fluticasone. He can return to school when he does not need albuterol more often than every 4 hours. Call the emergency room right away if he needs albuterol more often than every 4 hours, cannot speak in full sentences, his ribs pull in when he breathes, or his lips look blue. He will come back on Friday for a check-up and his flu shot. Your contact number and insurance were confirmed. Bring him if things get worse.
